title: The Last Oath Again
author: Marguerite Montrose
blurb: Yara Hartwell, a cartographer of unmapped realms, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
